title: CyberGen
subtitle: Build log gallery
lede: A set of generators that turn a text prompt into a fully playable open-world city, in five stages: the layout (coast, districts, roads, buildings, transit), a 3D model for every building and street element, light and atmosphere, traffic and crowds, then story. An exporter imports each stage into Unreal Engine 5. The first two stages are built.
next: Next: stage 3, atmosgen (light, sky and weather), stage 4, lifegen (crowds, traffic, trains and aircraft), then stage 5, storygen.

stages.label: Stage 1
stages.name: layoutgen
stages.blurb: From a prompt to a complete city layout: water, districts, roads, buildings, transit, terrain, props and gameplay data, built as a Blender blockout and imported into Unreal Engine 5.8.

stages.label: Stage 2
stages.name: assetgen
stages.blurb: A unique 3D model for every building, plus streets, props, signs, water, ground and textures, each replacing its blockout piece in Blender and in Unreal.

stages.label: In Unreal
stages.name: exporter and run-throughs
stages.blurb: The one exporter every stage shares, and the run-throughs where a whole city is flown and walked in Unreal Engine 5.8 to find what to fix next.
